actions.action: Wait for new growth, then cut dead stems back to a living bud or lateral branch
Remove branches split lengthwise along the stem
Check flower buds to tell dead shriveled buds from plump living ones
If replacing dead plants, buy a cold-hardier Encore Azalea variety
Mulch with 3-4 inches of pine straw or bark in fall
Water before freezing weather if rainfall has been scarce

verdict.reason: The answer correctly identifies recoverable winter damage and advises patience, but it focuses on pruning and future protection, mentioning watering only before freezes and never fertilizing, so the actual fix is only partly covered; nothing harmful is advised.
